biography: Carlos Alves, born in the bustling favelas of São Paulo, Brazil, discovered racing through a gritty, informal karting scene. Scrounging parts and hustling for track time, his raw talent quickly became undeniable. He made his way into the CA Competicoes racing academy, where his aggressive style both thrilled and terrified his instructors. A defining moment came during the Brazilian Stock Car Light series, where, after starting last due to a mechanical failure, he clawed his way to victory, showcasing his relentless determination. Now at 29, Alves is considered to be at his peak, a force to be reckoned with in the TC2000 championship, constantly pushing the limits of his car and his rivals, striving for that elusive championship title.
drivingStyle: Alves is known for his highly aggressive, 'no-holds-barred' driving style. He's a late-braking specialist, often diving into corners where others wouldn't dare. While this approach can lead to spectacular overtakes, it also results in the occasional crash and tire wear issues. He thrives under pressure, often performing best when the stakes are highest, displaying a remarkable ability to focus and extract maximum performance from his machine when it matters most.

careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian Stock Car Light championship in 2020 after overcoming numerous challenges and setbacks, proving his resilience and determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 2022 TC2000 championship race due to a mechanical failure, costing him the title.
